entities.summary: Dobropillia is a city in Pokrovsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine. Prior to 2020, it was a city of oblast significance and served as the administrative center of the former Dobropillia Raion, though it was administratively separate from the raion. It is located 94 kilometres (58 mi) from Donetsk, the administrative center of the oblast. In 2022, 28,000 people lived in Dobropillia, and in 2025, approximately 22,000 did.
